name: YTKACE
description: YTKACE mod. Includes no ads, background playback, downloads, iSponsorBlock, PiP, and more.
changelog:
YouTube 21.35.3 | YTKACE_21.35.3_0.9.2

### Latest Release, ENJOY!!
#### A new free YouTube enhancer for iOS with downloads, iSponsorBlock, player controls, and interface customization.
> [!NOTE]
> - [Altstore source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrdrvt99/Altstore-Repository/main/ytkace.json) is available now!.
> - no YTUHD. it is broken in +21.25.5 versions as of now. max resolution is 1080p60. devices with native AV1 can still see 4K.
> - [v0.9.2 release notes](https://github.com/itzzace/ytkace/releases/tag/v0.9.2)
> - - -
> #### Extra Tweaks:
> - `YouPip` `YTABConfig` `YouQuality` `YouChooseQuality`  `YouGetCaption` `YTHoldForSpeed` `YTNativeShare` `YTweaks`
> -  `Return-YouTube-Dislikes` `DontEatMyContent` `Open in YouTube (Safari Extension)` `Gonerino`  `VolumeBoostYT` `PleaseDontStopTheMusic`

> [!IMPORTANT]
> - make sure you reapply tweak by pressing ✔ again after every sideload so background play/pip and cast work. 

> [!WARNING]
> - Extra tweaks that are bundled may be unstable on newer versions.

> [!WARNING]
> - 21.34.3+ builds require iOS 17+ now.
